analysis.outline: One-pixel dark brown contour; #160f09 exists in Furniture.png and the formal UI palette. No external cast shadows.
analysis.shading: Flat material ramps; wood uses #341f12/#5a361e/#7d4c28/#a96c3f, rope uses UI highlight/text. No random texture noise.
analysis.lighting: Upper/left-facing edges highlighted; lower/right hull faces shadowed. Inferred visually from wooden doors, barrels, planks and furniture.
analysis.pixel_density: 1px features at native scale; environment TileSet uses default 16px cells. Boat hull about 5-6 tiles long, with fixed 128x128 transparent cells to accommodate outriggers and all views.
analysis.characters: idle.png is 832x256 with small visible characters in padded cells; player.tscn declares 128x128 atlas regions. Those existing assets/settings are not modified.
analysis.design: Small open wooden Filipino bangka with identical hull/outrigger geometry within each view across basic/equipped/upgraded levels. No mast, sail, canopy, combat equipment, or baked water.
